message: You know, there’s something a bit funny about being caught off guard. Like the time I thought I’d whip up a gourmet dinner, only to realize I was missing half the ingredients! 🍳 It’s the same with being prepared for unexpected events — a little planning goes a long way. This resource on financial preparedness is a great reminder that a little foresight can help us navigate life’s surprises with a bit more grace. Have you ever had a moment where you wished you’d been more ready?
